drg.description: Simple Pneumonia and Pleurisy with MCC

timeline.text: Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity

notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed. 68-year-old female admitted for community-acquired pneumonia. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.89, creatinine 0.96, hemoglobin 13.5, pao2 58, platelets 237, sodium 140, wbc 7.4; vitals dbp 71-76, heart_rate 81-84, map 92-94, o2_flow 0-40, resp_rate 28-31, sbp 128-134, spo2 87-94, temp 36.8-37
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity; High-flow nasal cannula 40 L/min, FiO2 0.6
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Hypertension. Acute hypoxic respiratory failure.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Patient seen and examined at bedside. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 0.95, hemoglobin 13.4, platelets 243, sodium 140, wbc 7.2; vitals dbp 72-74, heart_rate 80-85, map 91-94, o2_flow 40, resp_rate 21-26, sbp 128-133, spo2 93-95, temp 36.9-37
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Hypertension. Acute hypoxic respiratory failure. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 68-year-old female, length of stay 5 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Community-acquired pneumonia. Hypertension. Acute hypoxic respiratory failure. Follow up with primary care in one week. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed.
